key_insight: Perfumer combines an LLM agent, predictive models, and Quantum ESPRESSO to accelerate structural relaxation and automate electronic-band prediction.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces computation and workflow setup for first-principles materials screening, accepting natural-language requests and uploaded or automatically constructed structures.
method: Pre-relax structures with Perfumer-relax, then refine with Quantum ESPRESSO.
Predict 12 band energies at requested wavevectors using a periodic graph neural network and latent Hermitian spectral head.
Preserve reciprocal-lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without explicitly constructing a Hamiltonian.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2.75× overall relaxation speedup; trained on 125,153 band structures, the band model achieved 0.157 eV median per-material MAE on 2,607 held-out-composition-family test materials, with inference taking about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores.
watch_item: Accuracy and relaxation speedup should be validated for target materials and settings beyond the reported evaluation, particularly where band errors could alter screening decisions.
paper_title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
